exchanges: Hi! Slow afternoon at the bakery so I'm finally sitting down with a tea.
Nice. How has the day been?
Good, but I'm exhausted. Being pregnant and doing 5am bake shifts is not a combo I'd recommend.
That sounds really tiring. How far along are you?
About five months. Baby's due in January, so right after the holiday rush, which Fatima says is terrible planning on my part.
The timing is tricky, but you will manage.
She's joking. Mostly. She's been amazing about covering for me.
Sounds like a good partner.
She really is. She's also moving soon, she and her husband bought a house in Oakville, so she'll have a longer drive in.
That is a big step for them.
My aunt Grace phoned this morning too. She's 70 and still tells everyone she went to McGill, like it was yesterday.
Some people stay proud of their school forever.
Ha, yes. And our dishwasher, also Grace, is doing her diploma at Seneca at night, so I'm surrounded by Graces and schools.
Two people named Grace with two very different school stories.
Exactly. My husband keeps calling them Grace One and Grace Two.
That is one way to keep them straight.
Thabo is ridiculous. He got promoted at Telus last week so he's been extra cheerful.
Congratulations to him.
Thanks, I'll tell him.
Was it a big promotion?
Team lead. More meetings, he says.
That usually comes with it.
We're going to watch my Springboks tonight, I grew up in Durban so rugby is basically religion in my family.
Sounds like a big night.
It is. Thabo pretends to care but he doesn't.
As long as he watches with you.
My best friend Valentina is getting married, she told me last night!
That is exciting news.
She wants to do it in Tuscany, at a villa her uncle knows. I'm already worried about flying that late in the pregnancy, or with a newborn.
That is a fair worry. Do you know when it will be?
Not yet, she's still working it out.
There is time to plan.
Ok correction, I just texted Fatima and it's Burlington, not Oakville. I always mix up those two.
Thanks for the correction.
One of the regulars, Kenta, was reading Shantaram at the counter today, it's huge, like a brick.
That is a long book to carry around.
He said he's been on it for a year lol.
Some books take their time.
I speak Afrikaans with my mom on the phone but I'm getting rusty since I moved here.
Regular calls will help keep it up.
True. She'd kill me if I lost it.
Then the calls are important.
Ok, the after-school crowd will be here soon.
Time for cookies then.
Always cookies. The kids love the sprinkle ones.
Sprinkles never fail.
Before they come, which school did my aunt go to? Valentina's cousin is applying there and I want to tell her.
Here they come, the door is going nonstop.
Good luck with the rush.
Valentina just texted, it's going to be June! So I'll have a five month old. Fine. Totally fine.
A baby that age at a wedding can work, people do it all the time.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your aunt Grace went to McGill.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your aunt Grace went to Seneca.

questions.message: What book has Kenta been stuck on?
Where is Valentina having the wedding?
Which team do I support, remind me?
Fatima's moving to Oakville, isn't she?
The rush is finally over, phew.
Where did Fatima go to school?
What book is Thabo reading lately?
Sorry, which university was my aunt's?
